items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Russ and another guy by the name of Cooper. They were up there, and the Dorseys were up there, whom I hadn't met yet.

ctx.x: They had gone to the Sirens and now they were with Goldkette. There was Fuzzy Farrar the trumpet player whom I played with with one or two jobs with the Sirens and Itzy Riskin, the piano player who came from the south, and Russ and another guy by the name of Cooper. They were up there, and the Dorseys were up there, whom I hadn't met yet.
But you knew who they were.
